Officials Notified Over Voter List Errors During Delhi's SIR

During Delhi's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, errors were identified in the voter list, leading to notices being issued to several prominent individuals. Among those flagged are Election Commissioner SS Sandhu, Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri, former CJI DY Chandrachud, former Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar, and L.K. Advani. The action was taken by the Election Commission over discrepancies in the voter list. Arvind Kejriwal and his family also received notices, as did Rekha Gupta. The Election Commission's action is focused on addressing the reported flaws in the voter list during the revision process.
